newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly mid-distillates stocks at record.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly mid-distillates stocks at record.

text.p: Singapore weekly middle distillates stocks for the week ending June 11 rose to 11.236 million barrels, the highest since at least January 1994, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) statistics showed on Thursday.
Middle distillates stocks rose 993,000 barrels from the previous week's level of 10.243 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise gas oil, jet fuel and kerosene.
